title: SOCIALGAZE: Improving the Integration of Human Social Norms in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual gender swapping of narrators and their romantic partners in social anecdotes using prompts, followed by measuring the shift in blame assignment (e.g., Not The Asshole vs. You're The Asshole) by the models.

Categorizing social anecdotes into three age bins (<20, 20-30, >30 years) based on the narrator's explicitly stated age, and evaluating the models' judgment performance (F1-scores) and alignment with human consensus across these demographic groups.
